description: A reusable search configuration resource. Bundles synonym sets, column analyzer overrides, and a default analyzer. Can be associated with projects or folders via the Project Settings framework for inheritance.

id.description: The unique ID of this search configuration.

organizationId.description: The ID of the Organization this resource belongs to.

name.description: Display name. Unique within the organization.

synonymSetIds.description: Ordered list of SynonymSet IDs to apply. Rules from all sets are unioned.

columnAnalyzerOverrideIds.description: Ordered list of ColumnAnalyzerOverride IDs to apply. First-found-wins for duplicate columns.

defaultAnalyzerId.description: Default text analyzer ID for columns without an explicit override.

etag.description: Synapse employs an Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) scheme.

createdOn.description: The date this resource was created.

createdBy.description: The ID of the user that created this resource.

modifiedOn.description: The date this resource was last modified.

modifiedBy.description: The ID of the user that last modified this resource.
